description: Issue #839: the declaration-slot rule applies at ANY nesting depth. `spec/grammar.md:93-94,147-148` makes a declaration an ordinary `statement` and a procedure body a sequence of statements, so declarations nest by construction, and phase-1 registration walks the whole program rather than only `program.body` (`spec/execution-model.md:82-89` registers "every `define`/`to` procedure", not every top-level one). Here `define forward` sits inside `define outer`, and the run halts before `outer` is ever called. This fixture exists because EVERY declaration in the corpus sat at column 1: measured, a mutant exempting non-top-level declarations from both guards passed the entire Definition of Done — 886 fixtures, 3915 tests, examples and markdown all green — while this exact program ran silently and emitted five events. Depth was a variable the corpus held constant, so nothing could see a guard that had quietly become top-level-only.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
